title: Understanding the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix, denoted as H, is used in linear regression to project the observed values onto the fitted values. It is defined as $$H=X \left(X^T X\right)^{\left(-1\right)} X^T$$.

title: Properties of the Hat Matrix
text: One key property of the hat matrix is that it is idempotent, meaning that $$H H=H$$. This property is crucial in understanding its behavior in projections.

title: Column Space and Projections
text: If a vector v is in the column space of X, then applying the hat matrix H to v will result in v itself, i.e., $$H v=v$$. This is because H projects vectors onto the column space of X.
